paragraphs.en: Authorities charged Eric Lewis, 35, with homicide in the killing of a police officer Saturday, Philadelphia District Attorney Larry Krasner said.
paragraphs.cn: 费城地区检察官拉里·克拉斯纳表示，当局以涉嫌杀人罪起诉了埃里克·刘易斯，现年35岁，他涉嫌于周六杀害了一名警察。

paragraphs.en: Shane Seiber, 40, was shot and killed after responding to a report of a man with a gun, police said. An officer who was with him was shot 12 times and is in stable condition, Commissioner Kevin Bethel said.
paragraphs.cn: 警方称，肖恩·塞伯，现年40岁，在接到关于一名持枪男子的报告后出警，并在此过程中被枪杀。与他一同出警的警察被枪击12次，目前情况稳定，凯文·贝塞尔表示。

meta.title: Man Charged in Officer’s Death
meta.title_cn: 一名男子因涉嫌导致一名警员死亡而被起诉。
